about: Lane SEA-SIG (2026-11-26, owner priority 3, the sea spectacle with the real animals aboard): sea animals aboard the live Ark (voyage_animals, read-only, 2026-11-26) whose own stored text says how they feed, shown with blocks and clips the scene already has (`recipe-templates-sea.ts`). Each row keeps its field and exact quote (AnimalDex docs/ark/signature-behaviours.json) and the line the live log says while the act is in view. (Cunner, titan triggerfish and moon wrasse were tried with a `peck` reef_pick and dropped: in the scene's own pictures the fish held its swimming pose mid-band, nose clear of rock and coral, so the pick did not read.)
